transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Can we just confirm—who's actually leading the pitch this time? I don't want us getting stuck like before.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I’m good with whoever steps up, honestly. But maybe someone just needs to say, ‘I’ll do it’ so we can move on. We can support from there.

transcript.name: Anna Kovačević
transcript.text: If no one else wants it, I'll lead the pitch. But I want Amitesh and Trang both involved—different strengths. Let’s decide now so we can start on substance.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Okay, Anna, I’m good with you leading. But can we just double-check—does anyone see a risk we’re missing if we set it up the same way as last time? I want to avoid getting stuck again.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Just so we’re clear—who’s making final decisions as we go? I want to avoid us getting stuck like last time. Maybe it’s Anna, but let’s spell it out.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Anna, thanks for stepping up. Can we talk through what happens if we run into a disagreement along the way? Just want to avoid us getting stuck again like before.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Maybe just to be clear—if Anna’s leading, does that mean she has the final call during the pitch prep? Or do we want to agree on how we handle it if there’s a big disagreement? I just want to avoid any confusion like last time.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: I’m good with Anna leading. Maybe just spell it out—she makes the call if we hit a snag? That way we’re not circling back and losing time.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: This is dragging on. Anna, you lead. You have the final say. Anyone with concerns, take them up after the meeting. We’re not losing another opportunity to hesitation. Understood?

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Just to make sure we’re all clear—Anna’s leading, but if anyone’s unsure about their piece, please just say so. I’d rather we check now than get stuck later.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: I’m fine with this setup. If anyone’s got doubts about what they’re doing, speak up now. Better to sort it here than get tripped up later.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I’m set to help. Just let me know which sections you want me to own, Anna, so there’s no overlap or stuff slipping through. Happy to handle API details if needed.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Anna, just let me know which parts you want me to cover. I’ll make sure I’m not overlapping with Amitesh or missing anything important.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: I’m clear on Anna leading and making the final call if needed. Just let me know which sections you want me to focus on, so I don’t double up with anyone.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: If anyone’s not sure about their part, please just mention it now. I’d rather we ask than have doubts later.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: I’m set on my end—just let me know if anyone needs a hand or if there’s a part that’s still not clear.

transcript.name: Anna Kovačević
transcript.text: Let’s keep it simple. I’ll make the final decisions if we get stuck, but I want everyone’s input before that point. Amitesh—API details are yours. Trang, focus on the client narrative. Lilian—data validation. If anyone’s unclear, say it now. Otherwise, we move forward.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Just want to check—does anyone feel unsure or worried about their piece? If so, don’t hesitate to say it here. Better now than after we start.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: If anyone’s uncertain, speak up. Otherwise, do your job. I won’t repeat myself.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Data validation—got it. I’m clear on my bit.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: No questions from me. API details—I’m on it. If anything gets unclear, I’ll let you know right away.

transcript.name: Anna Kovačević
transcript.text: Last check—if you’re unsure about anything, say so. Otherwise, let’s get to work. I’ll be here if questions come up later.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: Enough. Everyone knows their job. Don’t come to me with excuses later. Meeting’s over unless there’s something critical.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Alright, I’m clear on the client narrative. If anything comes up or if I need a data point from someone, I’ll just reach out. Good to get moving.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Alright, I’m good. If anyone runs into something or needs input on UI flows, just ping me. Otherwise, let’s get to work.
